text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One popular method is using SMART goals, which means goals should be Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. To track progress, it helps to set milestones—key points along the way where you check your work. Deliverables are the actual results or products you must complete, such as a report or a website. Finally, stakeholder alignment is important: everyone involved, including clients and team members, should agree on the goals from the start. When these elements work together, projects are more likely to finish on time and meet expectations.
